newsitem.title: USA: PacifiCorp in Philippines hydropower plant.
newsitem.headline: PacifiCorp in Philippines hydropower plant.

text.p: PacifiCorp, through an unregulated subsidiary, has purchased a one-third interest in a hydropower development project in the Philippines, the company said Friday.
The $145 million, 70 megawatt Luzon Hydro Project will be located on the Bakun River in northern Luzon island.
Construction is expected to begin this spring and completed by mid-year 2000.

PacifiCorp, which estimated its equity investment in the project at $15 million, said further opportunities are expected to arise as the Philippines prepares to privatize much of its thermal power generation and transmission.
Other partners in the Luzon plant are the Aboitiz Group of the Philippines and Australia's Pacific Hydro Ltd.
